#### Karmic Mirror
Tags: Reflection, Debt, Grace
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or a creature bound to you by a Karma talent is targeted by a hostile single-target effect
Cost: 4 CP and one matching Imprint
If the attacker carries one of your Debt Imprints, expend it and force the attacker to make a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The attacker is also affected by the hostile effect if it is a legal target.
Successful Save: The attacker takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
If the defender carries one of your Grace Imprints, you may instead expend that Grace Imprint to give the defender Advantage on the saving throw or impose Disadvantage on the attack roll.
Karmic Mirror cannot reflect area effects, Secret effects, or effects with no meaningful source unless the GM permits it.
